Vale China tariff OR trade restriction 2026 iron ore

findings.claim: Vale 20-F 揭露：2025 年對中國客戶銷售占淨營收 51%；關稅、制裁環境或中國需求變動可能降低產品需求與營收。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2025 風險因素
findings.excerpt: The percentage of our net operating revenue attributable to sales to customers in China was 51% in 2025. Therefore, any contraction of China’s economic growth or change in its economic profile, or changes in tariffs or in the political or sanctions environment globally could result in lower demand for our products, leading to lower revenues, cash flow and profitability.

findings.claim: Vale 20-F 揭露：作為鐵礦與鎳供應商，面臨關稅、進出口管制及貿易壁壘對自身及客戶產品的影響，整體衝擊難預測。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2025 風險因素
findings.excerpt: As a supplier of iron ore, nickel and other raw materials to the global integrated steel industry and to other metal-consuming sectors such as battery production and other specified, industrial end-uses we are subject to additional risk from the imposition of duties, tariffs, import and export controls and other trade barriers impacting our products and the products our customers produce.

findings.claim: 20-F 指出 2025 年日本、南韓粗鋼產量分別年減 4.0%、2.8%，反映關稅不確定性影響出口與需求。
findings.excerpt: Compared with 2024, steel production in 2025 declined by 4.0% in Japan, to 80.7 Mt and 2.8% in South Korea, to 61.9 Mt, reflecting an industrial environment marked by uncertainties related to tariffs, which affected exports, weakened demand, and intensified competition from Chinese steel exports.

findings.claim: 搜尋未見 2026 年針對 Vale 的中國官方貿易限制；2026 年 3 月中國限制的是 BHP 鐵礦（非 Vale）。Section 232 2026 調整僅涵蓋鋼、鋁、銅，搜尋結果未提及鐵礦或鎳。
findings.source: WebSearch 摘要（Vale China tariff 查詢；Section 232 查詢）
